items.q: Woody Allen plays in the theme of George Lewis. It's a sad thing that... It's a lamentable thing, the way he plays.

ctx.x: Yeah. He is. I know who you're talking about -- Woody Allen.

That's one reason why I fell out of the Preservation Hall, because I played spirited banjo, the Figure-Eight stroke and...you know...
